name: Elixirs for the Bladeleafs
summary: Syral Bladeleaf seeks help keeping her family’s busy trade supplied in Dolanaar. Her husband spends nearly all his time brewing, and fresh elixirs could ease his workload while earning the brewer uncommon herbs.

sections.title: A Burden of Prosperity
sections.body: Dolanaar draws travelers, sentinels, and druids moving through Teldrassil. Syral Bladeleaf and her husband have built a flourishing herb and alchemy trade to serve them. Demand keeps her husband bent over vials and cauldrons for nearly all his hours, leaving the couple little time together.

sections.title: A Trader's Exchange
sections.body: Syral turns to passing herbalists and brewers to ease her husband’s workload. She asks for Elixirs of Lion's Strength and Minor Defense, offering freshly gathered, uncommon herbs in exchange. For a fledgling alchemist practicing beneath the Great Tree, the exchange brings a bundle of herbs and a chance to turn common forest flora into coveted regional flora.

faq.q: Why does Syral Bladeleaf need these potions?
faq.answer: Syral Bladeleaf’s family shop in Dolanaar has grown busy, and her husband spends nearly all his time brewing to meet demand. Having someone else prepare the elixirs gives him a much-needed break.

faq.q: What potions are required for the task?
aliases: what do i need to brew
faq.answer: Syral asks for six Elixirs of Lion's Strength and two Elixirs of Minor Defense. Adventurers and local sentinels in Teldrassil often buy both kinds.

faq.q: What herbs are needed to brew the required elixirs?
faq.answer: The batch calls for Silverleaf, Earthroot, and standard Crystal Vials. Silverleaf and Earthroot grow across Teldrassil’s forest floor.
This request is offered to alchemists with basic competence in the craft. Syral wants dependable, well-mixed remedies for her shop.

faq.q: What does Syral offer in exchange for the elixirs?
faq.answer: Syral offers a bundle of freshly gathered, uncommon herbs, difficult to find casually along Teldrassil’s woodland trails.

aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Syral Bladeleaf is outside the northern building in Dolanaar, near the central road through the forest village.

angles.text: Teldrassil’s rich soil holds Silverleaf and Earthroot, so you can forage the raw herbs for Syral’s shop order.
As a Night Elf, you know the Bladeleafs’ trade is part of Dolanaar’s life beneath Teldrassil’s canopy.
As an Alliance member, you can help keep Dolanaar supplied with restorative and defensive draughts for defenders and traveling allies facing woodland threats.
